word.name: tapestry-key-unique
word.title: Tapestry Key Unique
word.description: Each node has a tapestryKey, a random v4 UUID set once and never changed, and no two nodes share one.

graphRule.name: tapestry-key-unique
graphRule.says: each node has a `tapestryKey`, a random v4 UUID set once and never changed, and no two nodes share one. This is the owner's first core rule (design §7) and D6.
graphRule.kind: a graph rule, for every node, the web of trust's included.
graphRule.refusesOrReports: the database refuses a second node with a key another one holds.
graphRule.check: `lifecycle status`'s migrations part counts the nodes with no key, and says whether the uniqueness rule is in place.
graphRule.repair: `lifecycle migrate --migration tapestry-keys` gives every node that lacks a key one, along with the shared label.
